proof_body:
by
  intro a l h hl
  obtain ⟨r, hlr, hr1⟩ := exists_between hl
  have hl0 : 0 ≤ l := ge_of_tendsto' h (fun n => Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _)
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by linarith
  refine Summable.of_norm_bounded_eventually_nat (g := fun n => r ^ n) (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr1) ?_
  filter_upwards [h.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hlr), Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn hn0
  have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn0
  have h₁ := Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg (a n)) _) hn.le hn'.le
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul (abs_nonneg _), one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn'.ne', Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_natCast] at h₁
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h₁
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |a n| ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds l) → l < 1 → Summable (fun n => |a n|)
